title: [bug] audio recording via getUserMedia permission error
body: ### Describe the bug **This is only an issue in production build and when the app is notarized.** It throws error when I call `mediaDevices.getUserMedia({audio: true})`: ``` The request is not allowed by the user agent or the platform in the current context ``` ### Reproduction here's the repo I created using create-tauri-app: https://github.com/reporter-bot/tauri-audio-bug here's the changes: https://github.com/reporter-bot/tauri-audio-bug/commit/b580280c151259111e3c5bf67d324a2cd2a8e2c6 i already added `plist.info` and it still doesn't work see `build.mjs` to configure all the env variables needed for the build, then run `node build.mjs` ### Expected behavior should start recording audio ### Platform and versions ```text [✔] Environment - OS: Mac OS 14.1.1 X64 ✔ Xcode Command Line Tools: installed ✔ rustc: 1.73.0 (cc66ad468 2023-10-03) ✔ cargo: 1.73.0 (9c4383fb5 2023-08-26) ✔ rustup: 1.26.0 (5af9b9484 2023-04-05) ✔ Rust toolchain: stable-aarch64-apple-darwin (default) - node: 18.16.0 - pnpm: 8.10.0 - yarn: 1.22.19 - npm: 9.5.1 - bun: 1.0.11 [-] Packages - tauri [RUST]: 1.5.2 - tauri-build [RUST]: 1.5.0 - wry [RUST]: 0.24.6 - tao [RUST]: 0.16.5 - @tauri-apps/api [NPM]: 1.5.1 - @tauri-apps/cli [NPM]: 1.5.6 [-] App - build-type: bundle - CSP: unset - distDir: ../dist - devPath: http://localhost:1420/ - bundler: Vite ``` ### Stack trace _No response_ ### Additional context _No response_

Just move these into a separate plist:

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
  <dict>
    <key>com.apple.security.device.microphone</key>
    <true/>
    <key>com.apple.security.device.audio-input</key>
    <true/>
  </dict>
</plist>
```

and add it to tauri.conf.json:

```
"macOS": {
      "entitlements": "./entitlements.plist"
 }
```

comments.author: participant5
comments.body:
Just stumbled upon this thread and after a long time I realised that you need both the entitlements file *and* `Info.plist` for example (both in `src-tauri`):
- `Entitlements.plist`:
    ```
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
    <plist version="1.0">
      <dict>
        <key>com.apple.security.device.microphone</key>
        <true/>
        <key>com.apple.security.device.audio-input</key>
        <true/>
      </dict>
    </plist>
    ```
- `Info.plist`:
    ```
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
    <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
    <plist version="1.0">
      <dict>
        <key>NSMicrophoneUsageDescription</key>
        <string>Your reasons here.</string>
      </dict>
    </plist>
    ```
and you need `"Entitlements.plist"` in `bundle->macOS->entitlements` in your `tauri.conf.json` (as described [here](https://v1.tauri.app/v1/guides/building/macos/)).

comments.author: participant6
comments.body:
In case someone is running into camera permissions and runs into this, putting this into my Entitlements.plist solved the issue in release build:

```
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
  <dict>
    <key>com.apple.security.automation.apple-events</key><true/>
    <key>com.apple.security.device.camera</key><true/>
  </dict>
</plist>
```
